about: every dog leg chain, every frame: the analytic two-bone solution vs FABRIK (30 iterations, started bent toward the pole)
reading: measured: the two solvers agree (mean mid-joint difference 0.00007 m, 0 bend-side disagreements); the largest differences are in the few frames where the target is out of reach and the solvers straighten differently. FABRIK here is seeded bent toward the pole; unseeded it has no pole, which is why the film uses the analytic solver.
